notes: Word of the day: the daily card on Decks is now a ticket. Today's word sits on the red tear-off stub with its pinyin (gold foil to scratch until you uncover it), the meaning and a red Learn now button on the paper side. A faint picture on the stub changes every day: clouds, bamboo, a plum branch, distant mountains, lanterns. The word can now be one character or two (like 看见); the pop-up shows both, plays the strokes of one then the other, lets you write them in turn, and lists each character's meaning
